## What changed

Describe the reader-facing or implementation change and its scope.

## Verification and evidence boundaries

- [ ] Applicable checks passed on the proposed revision.
- [ ] Historical records and frozen inputs remain preserved.
- [ ] Software checks, AI-assisted proposals, human decisions and independent evidence are distinguished.

## Release documentation

- [ ] Release-facing changes are recorded in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased, or in the named release preparation.
- [ ] Release notes say what was included, what was verified and what remains unresolved.
- [ ] A new tag or archive has not been described as published before external verification.
- [ ] Exact-version DOIs are verified for that version; older identifiers are not reused.

Mark inapplicable items with a short explanation. Merge permission does not by itself satisfy publication or research gates.
